changelog:
Garmin Real-time Tracker initial release.

- Provides an overview of methods for real-time tracking and automated data delivery from Garmin devices.
- Documents approaches using Connect IQ apps, Garmin Health Companion SDK, Connect Activity & Health APIs, and unofficial LiveTrack solutions.
- Includes real-time streaming recommendations and integration options, with notes on stability and official support.
- Offers example resource organization for scripts, references, and templates.
